branding.tagline:
Bring the beauty and tranquility
of the ocean into your home.

paragraphs: My name is Adi Svara Welch, the founder of Santa Cruz Botanicals. I am a lifelong admirer of the ocean and a retired biology teacher with over 30 years in the classroom.
I create organic sea art using pressed seaweed collected from our local beaches of Santa Cruz, California.
Each piece is a unique expression of the ocean’s beauty, available in a variety of sizes, along with fine art prints that allow more people to bring a piece of the sea into their homes.
My mission is to share the wonder of marine life through art, inspire ocean education and conservation, and capture the deep sense of peace and connection we feel when standing beside the ocean.
Through my work, I hope to bring that same tranquility, beauty, and spirit of the sea into your home, wherever you may be.

gallery.title: Feather Boa Kelp
gallery.alt: Pressed sea lace artwork in a light wood frame
gallery.location: Sunny Cove Beach - Santa Cruz, CA
gallery.description: Feather Boa Kelp is a distinctive brown seaweed with a long, flexible central stem and numerous narrow, leaflike blades. Its feathered appearance resembles a decorative boa. Found along rocky shorelines, this resilient kelp sways with ocean currents and provides important habitat for marine life.

gallery.title: Red Feather Seaweed
gallery.description: This delicate red seaweed has intricate, featherlike branches in shades of burgundy, crimson, and deep purple. Its fine structure creates a beautiful, lace-like appearance. Red algae of this type grow attached to rocks and other marine surfaces along the California coast.

gallery.title: Feather Boa Kelp
gallery.description: Feather Boa Kelp is a beautiful brown seaweed native to the Pacific Coast, including Santa Cruz, California. Named for its resemblance to a long, feathery boa, this kelp features slender, ribbon-like fronds adorned with delicate leaflets and small air bladders. Its colors range from golden olive to deep brown. Growing along rocky shorelines, Feather Boa sways gracefully with the ocean currents, providing shelter and habitat for a variety of marine creatures.

gallery.title: Turkish Towel
gallery.description: Turkish Towel is a red seaweed commonly found along the rocky shores of Santa Cruz, California. Its broad, flattened blades range from deep burgundy to reddish-purple and often have a textured surface. This beautiful marine alga grows attached to rocks in the intertidal and shallow subtidal zones, providing habitat for small marine organisms.
